body: The record reflects that on the last date of hearing i.e 28.10.2026 brief was held on behalf of learned counsel for the appellant. It is observed that today learned counsel for the appellant Mr. Afzal Karim Virk appeared in some other cases and argued the matters; however, he chose to remain absent in the instant matter, which reflects that learned counsel for the appellant is not interested in pursuing the matter. Accordingly, this Court is left with no option but to dismiss the instant Criminal Acquittal Appeal for nonprosecution which stands dismissed for non-prosecution.
